policy.principle: A product must not need a fabricated efficacy claim merely to be published. Publication eligibility is separate from validated transformation efficacy.

rules.text: Individual progress metrics must measure before->after movement, never engagement/pages/quiz scores.
Measurement days (an observation window) must be declared.
A numeric threshold is an INTERNAL COHORT / LEARNING BASELINE unless supported by validated efficacy evidence; it is never published as proven efficacy.

A newly launched transformation with no validated efficacy is classified HYPOTHESIS_LEARNING_BASELINE and may still be publication-eligible when the Publication Constitution does not require validated efficacy.
The threshold is DERIVED by policy from the inputs; it is never a per-product human gate.
Publication eligibility must not depend on a fabricated efficacy claim.

threshold_derivation.pattern: P%+ of completers meet >=N of M stated indicators at Day X review
threshold_derivation.classification_rule: INTERNAL_COHORT_THRESHOLD when the pattern is derivable and efficacy is unvalidated; HYPOTHESIS_LEARNING_BASELINE when it is not derivable; EFFICACY_SUPPORTED only when validated efficacy evidence exists in the truth records; NOT_AUTHORIZED never (publication is independent of efficacy).

policy.external_presentation_rule: A hypothesis/learning baseline metric may be presented to the customer as a self-check target only, never as proven efficacy.

automatic_authorization_conditions: the threshold is derived by policy and classified (hypothesis/learning or internal cohort)
no fabricated efficacy claim is required for publication
automatic_rejection_conditions: a fabricated efficacy claim is required

provenance.note: Replaces the per-product owner threshold approval with a derivation policy; preserves the rule that the owner governs the policy itself.
